_README: Edit these values for each client, then run: python3 _build/build.py && python3 _build/qa.py. Values marked SAMPLE must be replaced before launch. Keep demo_mode true until real client details are in; it adds noindex to every page and the yellow demo banner. accent: brand colour #rrggbb used for buttons and highlights (the build stops if it is too dark to read). accent_alt: the second colour used for live circuits and the gradient (#rrggbb). logo: path to the client's logo, e.g. assets/img/client/logo.png (transparent PNG best); empty = built-in mark + name. services: remove any slug the client does not offer, then fix any sentences listed in _build/removed-service-mentions.txt. photos: the client's own job photos only (see _build/photos.py). licence_number: the client's ESA Licensed Electrical Contractor (LEC) number, shown in the footer and on the about page; leave empty until the client confirms it (nothing is shown). intro: false turns the opening animation off; intro_scope 'all' plays it on whichever page a visitor lands on first, 'home' limits it to the home page. house_scene: false turns off the scroll scene at the top of the home page (a house wired circuit by circuit as you scroll). emergency: true shows emergency call wording in the header area and hero; set it to false if the client does not take after-hours calls. estimator: see the _README inside it.
emergency_note: Sparks, burning smell or no power? Call now.

estimator._README: Instant electrical estimate (/electrical-estimate/). Set the client's real prices (CAD) before launch. Everything runs in the visitor's browser; nothing is sent until they submit the form. jobs: one entry per job type the tool prices; 'service' hides the job when the client doesn't offer that service; remove a job to drop it. base = starting price for the job. inputs: 'range' (slider; per_unit = price per unit above free_units), 'count' (stepper; per_unit = price each), 'choice' (radio; add = amount added, mult = multiplier applied to the job's unit-priced work, i.e. its range and count inputs; note = text shown when chosen), 'check' (checkbox; add = amount added; 'service' hides it when not offered). Job total = (base + choice adds + check adds + unit-priced work x choice mults); then +/- range_pct, rounded to round_to, never below minimum_job. permit_included: true says on the result that the ESA permit and inspection are included; set false if the client prices them separately.
